score_meaning: Concept novelty only, not acceptance probability; missing RTL/PPA does not lower this score

reviews.subject: C1 shared contribution and spatial-boundary representation
findings: Multi-consumer signatures, small-slot selection and fixed-slot compression already have local results; do not rediscover them
APEC local intersection is not disproved by the distinct M2271 organization's negative result
Spatial boundary convolution is exact for fixed theta amplitude, but differential convolution is prior art
Length-weighted BN and full-T interval union could consume runs, but staggered sparse channels can create a breakpoint at every pixel
Logical C1 channels are 768 and spatial size 15x20; 96 is execution width
reviews.source_access_limit: Diffy original PDF unavailable to reviewer; official MICRO program and author material support the nearest-prior identity, not exhaustive exclusion of all details
reviews.decision: No new C1 production RTL or repeated workload screen

reviews.subject: Causal motion residual with dynamic default state and real-valued exceptions
findings: Motion-aware Event Suppression already combines future motion masks with token pruning
DFlow already adapts iteration count using anticipated flow improvement
Graham CVPR2018 already has a shared, potentially nonzero ground state
Remaining proposal changes the new network's state representation under complete current-domain BN, full-T PSN and theta amplitude
Default locations have current real values, never implicitly zero; locally different theta requires real exceptions
Periodic textures and aperture ambiguity can yield small residuals with wrong flow; residual is not an accuracy certificate
reviews.decision: Retain as a separately trained co-design candidate, not as a second proven high-novelty RTL mechanism

reviews.subject: Interval packet encoder, verifier and full-T commit RTL
findings: No obvious error found in interval comparison, reversed endpoints, finite-width distance or final-beat logic for reviewed configurations
Independent CHECK state resolves nonblocking last-beat error/replay updates before group output
Group output zero before RESULT prevents partial consumption followed by duplicate full-T recovery
Opaque theta payload is preserved; interval generation and recovery arithmetic remain external
Gist and speculative BN/rollback are direct prior art; completing this RTL does not raise novelty score
requested_fixes: Document all three modules and distinguish failure-cause mask from full-T recovery extent
Test simultaneous response consumption and replacement, and held-valid backpressure
Test multiple failures, packet and repair identity errors, malformed base and group-state resets
reviews.coordinator_resolution: Contract synchronized; r3 adds these tests and B5/T3 out-of-range-index configuration. Five configurations passed; see functional_r3/result.json.
reviews.final_targeted_followup: Reviewer reread new group/consecutive/reset tests and r3 receipt; confirmed requested coverage and unchanged RTL/source hashes. Test gaps closed without further expansion. Reviewer did not rerun simulation; concept score unchanged.
